kev_metadata.requiredAction: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev_metadata.shortDescription: Perforce Puppet Enterprise contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Puppet’s report-processing code that allows a client with any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as the service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type through a PUT request. If the certificate authority automatically signs requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain a valid certificate and exploit the vulnerability.
kev_metadata.vulnerabilityName: Perforce Puppet Enterprise Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
